_comment: Precomputed average colour (rgb 0..1) of each shipped skybox set's front face, used by world/skybox's star-colour matching (docs/WORLD.md 'Skybox matches the star'). Generated once offline from assets/skybox/bkg/<key>/front.png (a box-downscale to 1x1) so the game never has to fully decode all 18 sets' images at startup just to compare colours - one of those images is 4096x4096, and decoding all of them synchronously was measured at ~0.6s alone, on top of the normal cost of decoding the actually-displayed set, making the game hang for a noticeable moment on startup. If a set is missing here (e.g. the user adds a new one), world/skybox falls back to decoding it at runtime and caching the result under cache/skybox/, exactly as before - this file just removes that cost for the sets that ship with the game.
